newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP FY97 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP FY97 EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she cut her earnings estimate for meat processor IBP Inc to $2.55 a share from $2.90.
-- IBP recently reported fourth quarter 1996 earnings of $0.19 a share, which compared with Wittenburg's estimate of $0.20 a share but below the Street consensus of $0.29.
-- During the quarter, IBP made some beef and pork slaughter plant cutbacks, giving up a little market share in order to protect its profits, she added.
-- IBP's exports were down 25 percent in the fourth quarter and down eight percent for 1996.
-- For the full year 1997, Wittenburg said the wild card will be exports.

-- "Full year outlook on beef depends on slaughter supplies, and there could be some continued liquidation at the cow-calf operator level," she said. "Steer and heifer supplies are expected to be strongest around June and then decreased in latter part of the year."

-- Pork should be better as IBP faces easier comparisons. The full-year impact of IBP's Alberta, Canada, expanded beef processing operation is hard to judge, Wittenburg said, and likely will depend on the level of export demand.

-- "Another wild card in 1997 pertains to pork slaughter capacity," Wittenburg said. "If some marginal producers are squeezed out -- which we believe could be possible -- then IBP's pork earnings would improve more quickly."
-- Dain Bosworth has a buy rating on the stock, which was up 1/2 at 23-3/4 Monday morning.
